risk_if_not_implemented: Without Safety Integrity Level (SIL), Operational Technology (OT) and embedded systems may fail unsafely or be manipulated, endangering personnel, physical assets and process availability. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Safety Assessment
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to evaluate the safety aspects of embedded technologies via a fault tree analysis, or similar method, to determine possible consequences of misuse, misconfiguration and/or failure.
compensating_control_1.justification: Safety Assessment (EMB-19) provides periodic assessment and verification that compensates for the absence of Safety Integrity Level (SIL) (EMB-27) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Safety Instrumented System (SIS)
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to monitor and control hazardous processes to reduce the potential negative consequences of hazardous events.
compensating_control_2.justification: Safety Instrumented System (SIS) (EMB-25) provides safety assurance that compensates for the absence of Safety Integrity Level (SIL) (EMB-27) by providing alternative safety controls that reduce the likelihood and impact of unsafe conditions. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
